latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release supporting viral growth loop design and measurement:

- Enables product teams to classify viral loop types (7 kinds) and match to product context.
- Guides measurement and calculation of the viral coefficient (K-factor) including component breakdowns (invite, click-through, signup rates).
- Offers structured process for detecting and optimizing viral loop bottlenecks, with an emphasis on cycle time improvement.
- Provides practical safeguards against common viral mistakes and ensures viral is used appropriately per Bullseye framework selection.
- Suitable for startups, growth marketers, and product leads designing or troubleshooting viral/referral features.
